sample_data.reset_instructions: Use a fresh/incognito browser, or remove the localStorage key ledgerly-state-v1 and reload. Published fixture values can be entered through the salary/expense/pocket controls.

problem_solving_method: The team split P12 into four independently verifiable flows: expense capture, monthly analytics, deterministic forecasting, and savings/DPS planning. AI was restricted to receipt perception while all financial calculations stayed deterministic. The build was completed incrementally, then hardened with editable AI output, month-aware state, local persistence, saved-expense edit/delete, production smoke tests, and regression validation against all 25 published P12 cases.

R1.evidence: Live UI: Add expense and Scan receipt with editable extraction before save. Code: src/app/page.tsx and src/app/api/receipt/route.ts.

R2.evidence: Live dashboard: spent vs salary, available balance, category breakdown, largest expenses, previous-month comparison and month navigation. Code: src/app/page.tsx and src/lib/finance.ts.

R3.evidence: Live Forecast & insights section: projected spend, expected remaining spend, expected money left/shortfall and at least three amount-backed written insights. Code: src/app/page.tsx and src/lib/finance.ts.

R4.evidence: Live Savings pockets section: target/item/monthly contribution, forecast-adjusted contribution, completion date, editable DPS rate and compounded DPS return. Code: src/app/page.tsx and src/lib/finance.ts.

major_design_decisions: Use Gemini only for receipt-image perception; keep dashboard, forecast, insights, savings and DPS calculations deterministic in TypeScript.
Require editable human confirmation of extracted receipt values before saving.
Use browser localStorage for hackathon persistence to avoid unnecessary database/auth deployment risk.
Keep the ledger month-aware so historical and current expenses are not silently mixed.
Use integer-paisa handling and half-up monthly interest rounding for DPS calculations.
Use an explainable pace forecast: spent so far divided by elapsed days multiplied by days in the month.
Scale savings-pocket contributions proportionally when the forecast month-end savings budget cannot support all requested contributions.
Expose saved-expense edit/delete through View all transaction history while keeping aggregate dashboard cards read-only.
known_limitations: Ledger data is stored in browser localStorage and does not synchronize across devices.
No authentication, cloud backup or multi-user collaboration is included.
Receipt extraction quality and availability depend on the external Gemini service and image quality.
The spending forecast is a deterministic pace estimate rather than a long-history statistical model.
Savings pockets do not transfer real money.
DPS output is illustrative and does not model bank-specific taxes, fees or product conditions.
No automatic bank/payment transaction import or recurring-expense engine is included.
Production-scale rate limiting and abuse controls are outside the hackathon scope.
